That’s Right Too! ~
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y1qKwBEvF_E

The London Lasses and Pete Quinn perform a set of REELs (That’s Right Too) at the Markethouse, Miltown Malbay, Co Clare on Tuesday 1st June as part of their Ireland tour in promotion of new album, By Night & By Day. The first tune is led by box-player, Maureen Linane.

Re: That’s Right Too!

" so there is only one “Right” version--X5 above.
People may play it differently , chnge notes /phrases ect but they are not playing Liz Carrolls tune."

In my experience, that’s not at all how this music works. Even composers don’t play their own tunes one way and one way only, and Liz Carroll herself is an exemplar of creative variations. Never mind that X:1, as spare as it is, doesn’t feature Liz’s own ornamentation or subsequent variations. I’m sure she’s chuffed that so many people play and have recorded this tune and made it their own.
